plugin.name: Tripo
plugin.description: Generate, texture, remesh and animate 3D models with Tripo.
plugin.longDescription: Optional Beta for your Tripo API account. Includes text and image generation, multiview references, texturing, remeshing, rig checks and animation presets, balance and editable model versions. Requires OhMyGame API 2.16.
config.key.title: Tripo API key
config.key.description: Create an API key in your Tripo account. Generation and processing use your Tripo credits.
